The September print beat a reported 5.3% consensus by a wide margin, so upside surprises are possible, and previous revisions can move the September base. What would raise the answer: strong wholesale gasoline and diesel in October, a weak October 2025 comparison month, or another strong core reading. What would lower it: a fall in wholesale energy that follows retail gasoline. No October consensus was found.
